_note: Rohit's answers to common application questions (collected 2026-11-01). Use to auto-fill forms. Blank = not yet provided; ask in one batch.
reason_left_dmg: Left for a personal health reason (now recovered). The next month DealerOn/Sincro reached out and rehired him.
reason_left_dmg_script: I stepped away from DMG for a short personal health matter, which is fully resolved. Soon after, my previous employer reached out to bring me back, and I rejoined Sincro on the Inventory team.
reason_looking_now: Wants to work abroad and grow in AI.
reason_looking_now_script: I enjoy my work at Sincro, and the most exciting part of it has become the AI side, building Claude Code plugins and agent skills. I want to go deeper into that and do it at a company where AI is the core of the product, and I want the experience of working in an international team abroad. This role gives me both.

why_country_scripts.Germany: Germany has one of Europe's strongest engineering and AI scenes, especially in Berlin and Munich, and the EU Blue Card gives a clear long-term path. I want to build my career somewhere I can stay and grow for many years, not just a short stint.
why_country_scripts.Netherlands: Amsterdam has a very international tech community where English is the working language, and many of the companies I admire build their core engineering there. It is a place where I can contribute from day one and grow long term.
why_country_scripts.Japan: I have wanted to work in Japan for a long time. Its mix of engineering quality, strong AI investment and international tech teams is unique, and I want to build a long-term career there, including learning Japanese.
why_country_scripts.Poland: Warsaw and Krakow have become major engineering hubs for global companies, with strong teams working on real product and infrastructure problems. It is a great place to grow technically inside the EU.
why_country_scripts.Ireland: Dublin is the European engineering base for many of the world's leading tech and AI companies, it is English speaking, and the Critical Skills permit gives a clear path to stay long term.
